description.value: The Sage Pub is a neighbourhood pub and attached liquor store in Osoyoos, a key waypoint on the South Okanagan cycling corridor near the Canada-US border. It serves an extensive scratch kitchen menu spanning pub classics, hand-crafted pizzas, and shareable starters, and is known locally for its Thursday karaoke nights and Tuesday trivia. The attached Sage Liquor Store adds convenience for cyclists needing to resupply.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sagepub.ca confirms a full-service pub and liquor store at 6403 Cottonwood Drive, Osoyoos, BC V0H 1V3 with phone 250.495.2322; OSM had no address or phone so these are taken from the website. The menu navigation explicitly lists 'TAKEOUT & DELIVERY' confirming takeout; the pizza menu offers a gluten-free crust and a dedicated Vegetarian pizza, plus a Veggie Platter, confirming GF/vegetarian options. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or cycling infrastructure was found in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'The Sage Pub' but the website consistently uses 'Sage Pub & Liquor Store'.
Venue is 19+ only with two pieces of ID required — relevant for groups with younger cyclists.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website.
No bike parking or washroom evidence found; these fields remain unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, full-service pub in Osoyoos with takeout, a diverse food menu, and an attached liquor store — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists on the South Okanagan route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free pizza crust available; dedicated Vegetarian pizza (mushrooms, onions, green peppers, tomatoes, black olives, pineapple); Veggie Platter listed on menu
